verdict.rationale: Tavily documents an official `tvly` CLI. It covers search, extract, crawl and research from the terminal, browser-based `tvly login` with OAuth so no API key is hardcoded, and installs Agent Skills for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. That clearly targets AI-native workflows. The evidence comes only from llms.txt summaries. missing for 10: a dedicated CLI reference page or install command, documented flags beyond `--depth`, a map subcommand, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the official CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote:
tvly search "latest AI news"
tvly extract "https://example.com"
tvly crawl "https://docs.example.com" --depth 2
`tvly login` opens a browser for authentication. Then search, extract, crawl, and research from the terminal
Installing the CLI also installs Agent Skills for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex
OAuth 2.0 is supported, so no API key needs to be hardcoded.
